concepts.canonical_he: הצדקה פותחת ומרחבת הפתח יותר ויותר
concepts.gloss_en: Charity continually opens and widens the opening (petach) more and more — an aspect of 'patoach tiftach'

members.form: הצדקה פותחת ומרחבת הפתח יותר ויותר
פותחת יותר ויותר ומרחבת הפתח יותר

reason_for_human: Both occurrences sit in the same paragraph (LM 2:4) and express the identical idea — that charity opens and widens the petach 'more and more' as an aspect of 'patoach tiftach'. The two surface forms are just the same phrase captured with/without the leading 'הצדקה' and reordered slightly; same word, same meaning, no homograph issue. Grouping stands.
